doc: WHAT A PERSON WHO MAY NOT HAVE THE PAGE SEES, in the calculators' frame: not signed in, a card asks him to sign in, with a Sign in button that opens the login window (and, once he has signed in, the same question is asked again by itself: he gets the page if he is authorised and the refusal if he is not); signed in and not authorised, the refusal. I use the same words for the refusal whichever way he came to it.
